items.title: Industry body GJC alerts BIS over gold adulteration using Rhenium, Iridium
items.rss_summary: The All India Gem and Jewellery Domestic Council (GJC) on Friday said it alerted the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) about reports of the alleged use of Rhenium- and Iridium-based alloys to increase gold's weight, and urged the industry and consumers to remain vigilant. "While there have been media reports from certain quarters regarding the possible misuse of materials such as Rhenium and Iridium in gold, we want to assure the entire jewellery industry and all gold buyers that there is absolutely no reason to panic. The Bureau of Indian Standards is treating the matter with utmost seriousness," GJC Chairman Rajesh Rokde said in a statement. According to media reports, Rhenium- and Iridium-based alloys were allegedly used to increase gold's weight without a corresponding increase in purity.
